_comment: The previous panel (cassandra-standards plus four spec-flow lenses). Kept only for the benchmark quick loop (cpr bench --panel); not used by /review-pr.

lenses.name: cassandra-standards
lenses.focus: patch vs its JIRA ticket and Cassandra contribution standards

lenses.name: correctness
lenses.focus: logic, boundaries, error paths, concurrency, resource leaks

lenses.name: test-rigor
lenses.focus: regression-catching tests for the changed behaviour

lenses.name: observability
lenses.focus: logging, metrics, and diagnosable failure modes
